speech_style: Speak in natural everyday Filipino (Tagalog) as a warm community health trainer. Keep one stable adult female Kore narrator from heading to ending, including quoted dialogue; no character acting or speaker switching. Use gentle pitch and pace variation. Read Apple as written. Make hazard, possible harm, safe immediate action, contact verification and follow-up clear. Preserve every negation and unknown fact. Finish every word without adding a policy, diagnosis or completed correction. Keep a settled adult FEMALE narrator in a warm feminine mid register for this entire recording, including its heading and every separately supplied sentence. Each independent request is a continuation by the same Filipina woman with the identical vocal identity, pitch range and timbre. Do not use a male, baritone, lower announcer or secondary speaker for headings, prompts, quoted dialogue, caveats or the ending. Read exact words and negations with complete syllables; saka niya is sa-ka ni-ya, without changing words. Maintain gentle instructional variation inside that stable female register.

beats.text: Napansin ni Apple ang basang pasukan at mainit na ruta. Mula sa ligtas na puwesto, kinikilala niya ang panganib.
Basang sahig: maaaring madulas. Ilayo muna ang tao at humingi ng pagwawasto. Kailangan pang kumpirmahin ang contact.
Itinanong ni Apple kung sino ang aabisuhan at alin ang saklaw ng pagsasanay niya. Hindi siya nag-imbento ng sagot.
Sharps, impeksyon, strain, stress at aksidente: magkaibang panganib ang mga ito. Posibleng pinsala ang pinag-uusapan, hindi diagnosis.
Sa rehearsal, pinalitan ni Apple ang mag-ingat ng tiyak na ulat. Sinuri ng observer ang apat na field; saka niya inulit.
Iniulat ni Apple ang basang pasukan, panganib madulas at hinihinging aksyon. Kukumpirmahin niya ang contact at babalikan ang kalagayan. Hindi pa natin alam na naayos na.
